name: Regueras de Arriba (Spain)
description: Green field divided by a blue band edged white running from the hoist and forking to the fly corners, with a red triangle at the fly charged with the crowned municipal arms of Regueras de Arriba.
history: The municipal flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, the cloth green, divided in the middle by a blue stripe flanked with white and forked into two stripes of the same colour from the centre to the fly corners, with a red triangle at the fly bearing the municipal arms.

features.role: pall edged white from the hoist forking to the fly corners
Regueras de Arriba arms — tower, tree and column on white
